description: "Sir Harry Hotspur of Humblethwaite" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around Sir Harry Hotspur, the well-to-do baronet of Humblethwaite, and his complexities regarding family legacy, duty, and the challenges posed by his only daughter Emily's future.
